# GitVersioned

> One version for a whole repository, from git tags: resolved, stamped into every manifest, checked and released.

`gitversioned` resolves the version of a checkout from its release tags, stamps it into Python, Rust, npm, Helm and container manifests with scoped text edits, validates Conventional Commit titles and drives a reviewed release (changelog, release pull request, tag). It has three commands: `version`, `check` and `release`.
For the merged project configuration, source and guides, see [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt).

## Architectural Topography

### Configuration & Entrypoints
- [pyproject.toml](pyproject.toml): Project metadata, Hatch environments and tool settings.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Agent development guidelines, commands and security boundaries.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Pointer to `AGENTS.md`.
- [src/gitversioned/cli.py](src/gitversioned/cli.py): The command line. Commands:
  - `version`: print the version, the next one (`--next`), or stamp files (`--write`).
  - `check`: validate the setup, a title, a commit range (`--commits`) or a tag (`--tag`).
  - `release`: plan a release, update the working tree (`--write`), open the pull request (`--pr`), tag (`--tag`).
  - `init`: optional setup of the archive file.

### Core Library Modules
- [src/gitversioned/model.py](src/gitversioned/model.py): `Version`, printed as PEP 440 or SemVer.
- [src/gitversioned/config.py](src/gitversioned/config.py): The settings model, its homes and environment overrides.
- [src/gitversioned/git.py](src/gitversioned/git.py): Git access through subprocess, the archive file and sdist metadata.
- [src/gitversioned/resolve.py](src/gitversioned/resolve.py): Resolves the version of a checkout from its sources.
- [src/gitversioned/commits.py](src/gitversioned/commits.py): Conventional Commit parsing and bump rules.
- [src/gitversioned/editors.py](src/gitversioned/editors.py): Span locators for TOML, JSON and YAML values.
- [src/gitversioned/targets.py](src/gitversioned/targets.py): Discovery and stamping of the files that hold a version.
- [src/gitversioned/changelog.py](src/gitversioned/changelog.py): Changelog entries and sections.
- [src/gitversioned/checks.py](src/gitversioned/checks.py): Validation of the setup, titles, commits and tags.
- [src/gitversioned/github.py](src/gitversioned/github.py): The GitHub side, through the `gh` CLI.
- [src/gitversioned/release.py](src/gitversioned/release.py): Release planning, the release pull request and tagging.
- [src/gitversioned/scaffold.py](src/gitversioned/scaffold.py): The `init` step.
- [src/gitversioned/errors.py](src/gitversioned/errors.py): Errors and their exit codes.
- [src/gitversioned/logging.py](src/gitversioned/logging.py): Standard library logging setup.
- [src/gitversioned/plugins/hatchling.py](src/gitversioned/plugins/hatchling.py): Hatchling version source and build hook.
- [src/gitversioned/plugins/setuptools.py](src/gitversioned/plugins/setuptools.py): Setuptools integration.
- [src/gitversioned/plugins/maturin.py](src/gitversioned/plugins/maturin.py): Maturin wrapper backend.

### Testing Suite Tiers
- [tests/unit/](tests/unit/): Isolated tests of the version model, editors and commit rules.
- [tests/integration/](tests/integration/): Settings loading and build backends.
- [tests/e2e/](tests/e2e/): One class per user story, run through the command line in real git repositories.
- [examples/](examples/): Runnable projects, each covered by `examples/test_examples.py`.
